name: Apple___Apple_scab
cause: Apple scab is caused by the fungus Venturia inaequalis, which overwinters in fallen leaves and spreads during cool, wet spring conditions. Airborne spores infect young leaves and fruit, creating dark lesions and premature defoliation. This disease commonly develops under favorable environmental conditions such as high humidity, poor air circulation, excessive moisture, or infected crop residue depending on the crop type. The infection may spread through wind, rain splashes, contaminated soil, irrigation water, insects, infected seeds, farming tools, or nearby infected plants. Early symptoms usually appear on leaves, stems, or fruits and may include spots, discoloration, curling, wilting, fungal growth, or reduced plant vigor. If proper disease management is not followed, the infection can spread rapidly and reduce crop growth, yield quality, and overall productivity.
cure: Remove and destroy infected fallen leaves to reduce fungal spores. Apply preventive fungicides during early growth stages. Choose resistant apple varieties and ensure proper pruning to improve air circulation and reduce moisture retention. Regularly monitor plants for early symptoms and remove infected leaves, fruits, stems, or plant debris immediately to reduce disease spread. Maintain proper field sanitation, avoid overcrowding, and ensure good air circulation around plants. Use disease-free seeds or resistant crop varieties whenever possible and follow proper crop rotation practices to reduce pathogen buildup in the soil. Apply recommended fungicides, bactericides, bio-control agents, or organic treatments according to agricultural guidelines and repeat applications during severe infection periods if required. Avoid excessive irrigation and maintain balanced fertilizer application to support healthy plant growth and improve disease resistance.

mr.cure: सल्फर फवारणी करा आणि हवा खेळती ठेवा. संक्रमित पाने, फळे आणि झाडांचे अवशेष काढून नष्ट करा जेणेकरून रोगाचा प्रसार कमी होईल. शेतात योग्य अंतर ठेवा जेणेकरून हवा खेळती राहील आणि आर्द्रता कमी राहील. रोगप्रतिकारक बियाणे आणि निरोगी रोपांचा वापर करा तसेच पीक फेरपालट पद्धत अवलंबा. आवश्यकतेनुसार शिफारस केलेली बुरशीनाशके, बॅक्टेरिसाइड किंवा जैविक उपचार वापरा. संतुलित खत व योग्य सिंचन ठेवा जेणेकरून झाडांची रोगप्रतिकारक क्षमता वाढेल.

name: Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles)
cause: Esca disease is caused by a complex of fungi including Phaeomoniella chlamydospora. It affects vascular tissues, causing leaf discoloration and vine decline. This disease commonly develops under favorable environmental conditions such as high humidity, poor air circulation, excessive moisture, or infected crop residue depending on the crop type. Use disease-free seeds or resistant crop varieties whenever possible and follow proper crop rotation practices to reduce pathogen buildup in the soil. Apply recommended fungicides, bactericides, bio-control agents, or organic treatments according to agricultural guidelines and repeat applications during severe infection periods if required. Avoid excessive irrigation and maintain balanced fertilizer application to support healthy plant growth and improve disease resistance.

Apply recommended fungicides, bactericides, bio-control agents, or organic treatments according to agricultural guidelines and repeat applications during severe infection periods if required. Avoid excessive irrigation and maintain balanced fertilizer application to support healthy plant growth and improve disease resistance.

mr.cure: संक्रमित पान काढून टाका आणि सूचित केलेली प्रकारची कम्पोजिट कम्पोजिट करा. संक्रमित पाने, फळे आणि झाडांचे अवशेष काढून नष्ट करा जेणेकरून रोगाचा प्रसार कमी होईल. शेतात योग्य अंतर ठेवा जेणेकरून हवा खेळती राहील आणि आर्द्रता कमी राहील. रोगप्रतिकारक बियाणे आणि निरोगी रोपांचा वापर करा तसेच पीक फेरपालट पद्धत अवलंबा. आवश्यकतेनुसार शिफारस केलेली बुरशीनाशके, बॅक्टेरिसाइड किंवा जैविक उपचार वापरा. संतुलित खत व योग्य सिंचन ठेवा जेणेकरून झाडांची रोगप्रतिकारक क्षमता वाढेल.

Avoid excessive irrigation and maintain balanced fertilizer application to support healthy plant growth and improve disease resistance.

cure: Remove infected plants and disinfect tools. Regularly monitor plants for early symptoms and remove infected leaves, fruits, stems, or plant debris immediately to reduce disease spread. Maintain proper field sanitation, avoid overcrowding, and ensure good air circulation around plants. Use disease-free seeds or resistant crop varieties whenever possible and follow proper crop rotation practices to reduce pathogen buildup in the soil. Apply recommended fungicides, bactericides, bio-control agents, or organic treatments according to agricultural guidelines and repeat applications during severe infection periods if required. Avoid excessive irrigation and maintain balanced fertilizer application to support healthy plant growth and improve disease resistance.
